name: WireGuard client
packageArguments: Base64-encoded UTF-8 JSON object. Install/Update/Repair need TunnelName, Address (IPv4 CIDR), ServerPublicKey, Endpoint (host:port), AllowedIPs (comma-separated IPv4 CIDRs, no 0.0.0.0/0). Optional: PersistentKeepalive (default 25), NrptNamespaces and NrptServers (comma-separated, together), DisableGsaPrivateAccess (true|false, default false), Mode=Check for a read-only report. Uninstall needs TunnelName only. Intune actions (docs/wireguard-client.md): Prepare (key only; also MapUrl, MapKey, TrustedGateways, TrustedGatewayMacs, optional LegacyPattern), Report, Apply, Revoke, Rotate; without TunnelName they read tenant.json.
